details.reason: Withhold after independent risk audit (learner-critical-answer): The card conflates a vehicle gear/transmission with the control used to select gears. Indonesian “persneling” commonly denotes the vehicle’s gear/transmission mechanism, while Malaysian DBP terminology for “gearshift” is “penganjak gear”; “gear” alone normally denotes a gear, not specifically the gear-shift control. The relation and cue therefore do not support a clean Indonesian–Malaysian contrast. No specific false-friend contrast is supplied. Retain outside promotion pending a vetted correction and fresh current clearance.
